text: Semiconductor equities declined across South Korea, Japan, Taiwan, Europe, and U.S. premarket trading. SK Hynix fell 14.65%, Samsung Electronics over 13%, Tokyo Electron 10.96%, Advantest over 10%, Kioxia over 18%, TSMC nearly 3%, and ASML more than 2% in Europe after prior losses. The selling occurred across memory, equipment, foundry, and AI-related firms.

meta.note: Broad synchronized declines coexist with differing regional and company-level magnitudes.

text: Coca-Cola reported quarterly revenue of $13.38 billion, adjusted earnings per share of $0.97, organic revenue growth of 6%, and global unit case volume growth of 5%. All reporting segments recorded volume growth. The company raised its full-year earnings-per-share and organic revenue guidance.

meta.note: Marketing activity coincides with results but is excluded as causal attribution.
